items.control_name: Enforce Hardware MFA on AWS Root Account
items.description: The AWS Root account must have a dedicated Hardware MFA token enabled and no active access keys.
items.current_value: Root MFA Enabled = True, Active Access Keys = 0
items.remediation_notes: Secure physical hardware token in enterprise fireproof safe.

items.control_name: Rotate IAM User Access Keys Every 90 Days
items.description: All IAM user programmatic access keys older than 90 days must be deactivated and rotated.
items.current_value: 4 IAM users have access keys > 90 days old
items.recommended_value: 0 keys > 90 days old; migrate to IAM Roles / OIDC
items.remediation_notes: Deactivate stale access keys for 'legacy-jenkins-bot' and 'developer-svc'.

items.description: Password policy must require minimum length >= 14, uppercase, lowercase, numbers, symbols, and 90-day expiry.
items.current_value: Minimum length = 14, Symbols required = True, Max age = 90 days
items.recommended_value: Min length 14, all complexity rules enabled, max age 90 days
items.remediation_notes: Prefer IAM Identity Center (SSO) with enterprise IdP over local IAM passwords.

items.control_name: Enforce AWS IAM Identity Center (SSO) for Human Users
items.description: Human users must authenticate via AWS IAM Identity Center integrated with Google Workspace / Okta.
items.current_value: IAM Identity Center active; 3 legacy IAM users still login via console
items.recommended_value: 100% human login via IAM Identity Center
items.remediation_notes: Remove console login profiles for the 3 remaining local IAM users.
